name: Dash momentum storage: a ground dash holds the momentum through friction and gives 95% back at its end
techNote: The dot starts in the air (x -300, y 80) with momentum.x 2000, stick right, over a floor (top y 0, x -400-620); past it a spike pit (strip x 620-1800, y -432 to -400) and a platform (top y -300, x 1800-2200) with the finish box on it. A dash on the landing tick (tick 12) moves momentum into preDashMomentum (1643-1644): 1448.2 is kept through 11 ground ticks of dash, where friction would take x0.75 a tick. Its natural end (tick 23, 1143) gives 95% back (sign matches, dash not up, 2030-2033): momentum.x 1375.5, and a jump on that tick (the input after the dash's) is a plain 805 jump with it, onto the platform (x 1916 at y -268). A jump during the dash is a super (CheckForSuperJump, 1406, never calls endDash): the stored momentum is lost for the super's 900, at best x 1577 there; a landing-tick jump with no dash reaches x 1618. Both fall into the spikes.
